name: Notion
author: hearth-team
description: Read + write your Notion workspace via the official API. Pass `action` ∈ search / get_page / get_database / query_database / create_page / update_page / get_block_children / append_blocks plus the action-specific args. Use this to look things up in Notion, log entries to a database (CRM, tasks, content calendar), or read a page's content. Stored API key, gmail.readonly-style least privilege: the integration only sees pages you explicitly share with it.

vault_inputs.label: Notion integration secret
vault_inputs.help: 1) Create an internal integration at https://www.notion.so/my-integrations → copy the 'Internal Integration Secret'. 2) CRUCIAL: open each Notion page/database you want the agent to touch → ••• menu → Connections → add your integration. Notion only exposes content you've explicitly shared — a 'no results' search usually means the page isn't shared yet. Stored encrypted in your vault.
